# Database fixtures from earlier builds

Each directory is a database written by an EARLIER build of Flats, opened by
`tests/upgrade.rs`. Never edit them by hand; regenerate with the build that
defines the old format.

## `wal6-catalog4/`

Written by `prod/15-coverage` (58b8bbd): WAL v6, catalog v4. Generated by
running this test in a worktree of that commit with
`FIXTURE_OUT=<dir> cargo test --release --test zz_make_fixture -- --ignored`,
then deleting `LOCK`:

```rust
use flats::{Db, DbOptions, Param};
use std::time::Duration;
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn make_fixture() {
    let out = std::env::var("FIXTURE_OUT").unwrap();
    let opts = DbOptions { checkpoint_interval: Duration::from_secs(3600), ..DbOptions::default() };
    let db = Db::open(&out, &[], opts).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE COLLECTION docs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, vector VECTOR(3), year INT, rating FLOAT, title TEXT) WITH (capacity = 64);").unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE COLLECTION gone (k INT PRIMARY KEY, vector VECTOR(2)) WITH (capacity = 8);").unwrap();
    for i in 0..20i64 {
        db.execute_with("INSERT INTO docs (id, vector, year, rating, title) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?);",
            &[Param::Text(format!("d{i}")), Param::Vector(vec![i as f32, 1.0, -0.5]), Param::Int(2000 + i),
              Param::Float(i as f64 / 4.0), Param::Text(format!("title {i} it's"))]).unwrap();
    }
    db.execute("UPDATE docs SET title = 'edited' WHERE year < 2005;").unwrap();
    db.execute("UPDATE docs SET vector = [9, 9, 9] WHERE id = 'd7';").unwrap();
    db.execute("DELETE FROM docs WHERE year >= 2018;").unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO gone (k, vector) VALUES (1, [1, 0]);").unwrap();
    db.checkpoint().unwrap(); // snapshots on disk
    // After the checkpoint: only in the WAL (v6 frames).
    db.execute("INSERT INTO docs (id, vector, year, rating, title) VALUES ('late', [0, 0, 1], 2030, 0.5, 'after');").unwrap();
    db.execute("DELETE FROM docs WHERE id = 'd3';").unwrap();
    db.execute("DROP COLLECTION gone;").unwrap();
    drop(db); // a crash: the WAL keeps the tail
}
```
